name: The Hunt Completed

meta.previous: Ursangous's Paw (quest), Shadumbra's Head (Classic), Sharptalon's Claw (Classic)

summary: In Ashenvale, the hunt tests a Horde champion against three legendary predators. Felling Ursangous, Shadumbra, and Sharptalon proves strength, tenacity, and primal prowess in a contested forest.

sections.title: A Hunter's Proof
sections.body: Senani Thunderheart tests travelers among the Horde forces in Ashenvale. Her hunt tests more than loyalty to the warchief; it asks whether a hunter understands survival in the wild. Three legendary predators are its quarry: the bear Ursangous, the cat Shadumbra, and the fierce hippogryph Sharptalon. Felling all three and securing their trophies proves a hunter's blood runs true.

sections.title: Honoring the Ancestors
sections.body: For the tauren, hunting is a sacred act of balance and respect, even in an active warfront. Overcoming Ashenvale's greatest terrors honors the spirits of the land and earns a hunter the ancestral blessings of Thunderheart. A formal commendation and token of favor mark the hunt's end, while the champion's reputation spreads throughout the forest.

faq.q: Who offers this quest and where are they located?
faq.answer: Senani Thunderheart, a tauren hunter, offers the hunt among the Horde forces in Ashenvale.

faq.q: What are the requirements to complete the hunt?
faq.answer: You must slay three great predators and bring proof of their deaths: Ursangous's paw, Shadumbra's head, and Sharptalon's claw.

faq.q: Why does Senani Thunderheart want these beasts slain?
faq.answer: The hunt tests strength and tenacity. Felling such formidable beasts proves a traveler has the heart and instincts of a predator able to survive Ashenvale's dangerous wilderness.

faq.q: What is the cultural significance of the hunt to the Horde?
faq.answer: For tauren like Senani Thunderheart, testing your mettle against mighty beasts is an honorable tradition that honors the spirits and ancestors. It shows mastery of the wilderness without reckless dishonor.

faq.q: Is this trial recognized by the entire Horde?
faq.answer: Yes. Completing the hunt marks you as a proven hunter to the Horde forces in Ashenvale. You earn ancestral blessings and the respect of your comrades.

faq.q: Which three beasts are targeted in the Ashenvale hunt?
faq.answer: The three targets are Ursangous the great bear, Shadumbra the nightsaber, and Sharptalon the hippogryph.

angles.text: As a hunter, you prove your tracking and marksmanship against three of Ashenvale's greatest predators. Your instincts must match the wild beasts.
As a tauren, you honor a time-honored test of respect, balance, and ancestral pride by hunting Ursangous, Shadumbra, and Sharptalon.
As a member of the Horde, you help secure your people's foothold in Ashenvale, a dangerous woodland filled with predators and Alliance sentinels.
